scenario: A hospital is scheduling shifts across two departments — Oncology and Cardiology — over a three-day period: Monday, Tuesday, and Wednesday. Six nurses — Amber, Blake, Chen, Diana, Eva, and Frank — will be assigned to shifts, with exactly three nurses per day working in either the Oncology or Cardiology department. Each nurse works exactly once across the three days. On each day, the two departments must split the three nurses (at least one per department), and within each department on a given day, the nurses are ordered by their shift start time: morning (M), afternoon (A), and evening (E). No two nurses work simultaneously in the same department.
